output.content: The change adds ACME certificate profile selection, which only matters for ACME issuers. The environment shows a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It lists no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifest and no issuers or clusterissuers CRD, so it is unknown whether any ACME issuer is in use. Check whether the cluster has ACME Issuers or ClusterIssuers. The change appears opt-in, but the excerpt does not say what happens if no profile is set.
output.title: ACME certificate profiles: ACME issuer usage not shown in environment
